description: A4: the ten signature titans in the order the story meets them (docs/DECISIONS.md section 2.7): the save's titan records (schema 3: SaveSlots, ExpansionState) and the Character menu's Titans tab read this list. Only Stoneback is in the game yet; the others are slots the later milestones fill (their enemy and boss ids empty until then). The approved story names nine (Stoneback, the Ogre King, the Rootwarden, the Bastion Titan, the Frostbound Titan, the Stormcaller, the Cinder Titan, the Hollow Titan, the Worldbreaker); the tenth slot is held for the owner's tenth (docs/plans/FOLLOWUPS.md, From A4). A titan the giant has not met shows as unknown: the menu never names it.

titans.where: the old quarry beside Millford, in the Crownmarch
